text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Dammit...!
Can't believe I messed up like that...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Well, a scratch like this ain't nothin'.
Spit on it, and it'll be fine!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Let's get back to training soon, yeah?
choice_data_list: Make sure you get proper treatment for that!
If you're really sure you're fine, shall we do it?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Haa, I told you you're overreacting.
What are you, my mom?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh, don't look at me like that.
It's not like I wanted to trouble you...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Umm... All right, I get it!
I'll get it treated properly, okay?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Are you seriously acting like my mom? Jeez...

Vodka looked awkward and embarrassed,
but let her injuries be treated nonetheless.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah!
I know my own body better than anyone, y'know!

I returned to the training track with Vodka
to resume our practice, but...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'll show 'em.
An injury like this is noth—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
There might be, but
I-I'm fine...!
"Because Vodka pushed herself too hard while acting tough, it ended up taking much longer for her injury to heal."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Like hell I'd do something as lame
as whining over a little scratch like this!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you a run so cool
it'll blow all your worries away.

True to her word, Vodka powered through
her training just as she had before the injury.
